The Veterans Resource Center (VRC) assists veterans and veteran families (spouse/dependents)
with successfully transitioning into college and accomplishing their educational goals.
Our veteran student staff assists veterans and their families with the necessary applications
for admission, financial aid, and application of veteran education benefits which
share common values and similar educational goals. The VRC provides all of the necessary
tools for veterans/dependents to be successful throughout their college journey and
